Resolves #19069

Nested menu navigation sends an ID-only event path. An ancestor's nonmatching `#id` delegate previously fell through to class matching and threw on the absent `cls`. Make ID/class matching exclusive; preserve Navigator's payload and the existing physical/logical ancestry checks. Two regression cases also prevent a class from satisfying a same-named ID selector.

Change class: restoration (`fix`). Prescription checked: `src/manager/DomEvent.mjs#verifyDelegationPath` owns selector matching; changing Navigator's valid payload would hide the reader defect. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here (absent from Engine package scripts); local pre-commit baseline hooks passed.

Evidence: L3 (unchanged real-browser ContextMenuNL journey, exact head `2c83eb65d12674c4d75902a861f69478c1d5ed46`) → L3 required. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 — identify the responsible path/branch | Navigator `setActiveItem` emits `[{id}]`; default component ID delegates enter `verifyDelegationPath`. The nonmatching ID's class fallback is reproduced by the new unit arm and removed by the single condition change. |
| AC-2 — regression red before, green after | Outside-CI red control: both added cases fail on the original source (missing `cls`; ID falsely matches a class). CI-covered: `unit/manager/domEvent/Delegation.spec.mjs`. |
| AC-3 — unchanged full ContextMenuNL | Outside-CI: base `a186e92cfa34` fails with two delegation TypeErrors; this head passes the full file, including its original worker/page-error guards. |
| AC-4 — preserve ancestry controls | CI-covered: the four existing physical, portal, menu and unrelated-target cases remain unchanged in `Delegation.spec.mjs`. |

## Deltas from ticket

The missing classes are intentional in Navigator's synthetic path. Repair the selector branch rather than widening that payload or tolerating a malformed native event. No new API or file.

### `@neo-opus-ada` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-09-23T00:42:41Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — a one-condition restoration of the documented ID-delegate semantics in `DomEvent#verifyDelegationPath`, plus two red-first unit arms; no new surface, no contract change.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** Verified at `2c83eb65d1` against #19069's four ACs. The defect is exactly the ticket's: `(isId && id === item) || cls.includes(item)` let a missed ID selector fall through to the class branch, which throws on Navigator's deliberate `[{id}]` path and lets a same-named class satisfy `#id`. The ternary makes the branches exclusive and nothing else moves, so the Phase 1/Phase 2 ancestry code is untouched. Both new arms fail on the old condition — one throws, one returns `'submenu'` where `false` is right — and the `.root-menu` control keeps class matching honest. AC-3's real-browser receipt (ContextMenuNL 1 passed at this head, base 1 failed with the two TypeErrors) covers the tier CI does not run, and CI is green on all 34 checks. The thing I looked for and did not find: a remaining in-tree path that still throws. Both `neonavigate` listeners — ComboBox's list (`ComboBox.mjs:497`) and ListModel's view (`ListModel.mjs:123`) — take the default `#id` delegate. A *class* delegate on Navigator's ID-only path would still read `cls`, but no listener registers one, and #19069 puts broad selector parsing out of scope. One wording nit only: the new `@summary` says "ID-only paths need no class data", which is true of ID selectors on them, not of class selectors.

**Findings:** None.
